name: Payment - Milestone Based
text: The Client shall pay the Service Provider against completion and acceptance of defined milestones as set out in this Agreement or its Schedule. Each milestone payment shall become due only upon the Client's written acceptance of the corresponding deliverable, against a valid tax invoice, and shall be paid within thirty (30) days of such acceptance. Applicable GST shall be charged additionally, and the Client shall deduct TDS where required under the Income-tax Act, 1961. Disputed milestones shall not be withheld in their entirety where only part of the deliverable is in dispute; undisputed amounts shall be paid when due.

legal_basis.act: Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017
legal_basis.note: Time of supply of services for milestone-based billing

invalid_if: No milestones or acceptance criteria are defined
